provenance.faces: Traced from the game owner's own drawings (images the owner provided on 7 November 2026) by design/tools/character-pilot-trace.py. The source crops are design/character-pilot/faces/source/*.png, kept public with the owner's permission and never shipped; source/heads/ is the traced result, byte for byte the approved character pilot's.
provenance.drawn: Bodies, clothes, hands, the bandage and sling, the hanging-hair motion, the portrait and card frames and grounds, and the standee card are drawn in code (design/crew-drawing/source) on the approved rig. The standee keeps the rig standee's stand and clamp; the held devices are the shipped devices with the sleeve recoloured.
provenance.approval: Approved by the game owner on 7 November 2026 (PRs 191 and 192; docs/design/owner-decisions.md).
provenance.rights: Original work for the Mothership project. No third-party artwork, font, stock asset or photograph. Use inside the project only.

rules: Presentation only. Existing match tuples and source release catalogs remain unchanged. No gameplay, active defaults or deployment authority is added.
